description: This PHP class 'PaginationResponse' extends 'LinksResponse' and provides getter and setter methods for pagination link properties (first, prev, next, last). It implements a jsonSerialize method to output these properties in JSON format, serving as a response object for API pagination details.

classes.name: PaginationResponse
classes.description: A response class for API pagination, encapsulating pagination link URLs and JSON serialization.

methods.name: getFirst
methods.description: Returns the URL for the first page.

methods.name: setFirst
methods.description: Sets the URL for the first page.

methods.name: getPrev
methods.description: Returns the URL for the previous page.

methods.name: setPrev
methods.description: Sets the URL for the previous page.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the URL for the next page.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the URL for the next page.

methods.name: getLast
methods.description: Returns the URL for the last page.

methods.name: setLast
methods.description: Sets the URL for the last page.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes pagination links into a JSON-compatible array.
